name: Greater Shadow Crafting
body:
You can create even more powerful areas of darkness, and you are able to see normally in the dark areas you create with magic.

Prerequisite(s): Spellcraft 7 ranks, 5th-level Shadowdancer

Benefit: This feat functions as Shadow Crafting, except that you may also create the effects of a deeper darkness spell once per day per 2 levels of shadowdancer you possess. Additionally, you are able to see normally within any areas of darkness that you create with the darkness and deeper darkness spells that you create with Shadow Crafting. Finally, once per week you are able to make a single instance of a darkness spell permanent by performing a ritual lasting 10 minute. Your caster level for these effects is still equal to your shadowdancer level.
